description: Changes the payout to 2 [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Black Heart]][[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart]]s and 1 item from the [[Devil Room (Item Pool)|Devil Room item pool]]. If a [[Devil Deal]] has been taken, the payout is boosted to 3 Black Hearts and 2 Devil items.

Collecting [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Red Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Red Heart]][[:Hearts#Red Heart|Red Heart]]s, [[File:Half Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Half Red Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Half Red Heart]][[:Hearts#Half Red Heart|Half Red Heart]]s, or [[File:Double Heart.png|link=Hearts#Double Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Double Heart]][[:Hearts#Double Heart|Double Heart]]s with this item has a chance to transform them into [[File:Black Heart.png|link=Hearts#Black Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Black Heart]][[:Hearts#Black Heart|Black Heart]]s. When a heart is transformed in this way, a special sound plays and a black smoke puff appears. Does not work with [[File:Red Heart.png|link=Hearts#Scared Heart|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Scared Heart]][[:Hearts#Scared Heart|Scared Heart]]s.
Invokes the effect of [[File:Collectible Razor Blade icon.png|link=Razor Blade|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Razor Blade]][[:Razor Blade|Razor Blade]] along with its original effect.
Can be stacked along with The Book of Belial, allowing you to carry 2 passive books and an activated item on top of them.

Judas leaves a damaging flame trail while the invincibility is active instead of creating beams of light. Blocking damage just as the invincibility begins activates [[File:Collectible The Necronomicon icon.png|link=The Necronomicon|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|The Necronomicon]][[:The Necronomicon|The Necronomicon]] effect and grants Judas a temporary damage bonus.

Replaces the most recently acquired item with [[File:Collectible Pentagram icon.png|link=Pentagram|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Pentagram]][[:Pentagram|Pentagram]] instead of removing it. Birthright's effects will also change to that of the character transformed into.
The sword also increases Judas' damage by x1.4 then a flat +1 while it's active.

Grants temporary damage ups for every enemy/projectile hit by Dark Arts, similarly to [[File:Character Tainted Judas icon.png|link=Tainted Judas|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Tainted Judas|Tainted Judas]]. This stacks with [[File:Character Black Judas icon.png|link=Black Judas|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Judas#Black Judas|Black Judas]]' inherent version of this, doubling the amount of damage gained.
Grants Judas +2 damage and ×3 tears fired per second while his head is detached from his body.
Grants +2 damage up for the entirety of the new floor.
Grants a free [[File:Collectible Pentagram icon.png|link=Pentagram|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Pentagram]][[:Pentagram|Pentagram]] that will not be removed by Genesis.
Grants Judas +2.67 damage up while Glass Cannon is broken.

Also invokes the effect of [[File:Collectible Magic Fingers icon.png|link=Magic Fingers|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Magic Fingers]][[:Magic Fingers|Magic Fingers]] when used, which occurs after the damage increase and deals an additional +5 damage; non-boss enemies killed by this effect also have a chance to drop 1-2 pennies.
Grants a permanent 0.5 damage up for every converted heart.
Enemies Judas jumps through take ''2 + 0.2 × floor'' contact damage and are set on fire. The burn deals damage equal to Judas' damage, and ticks up to 5 times.
Gives a temporary +0.66 damage up with each use.
Fires a ring of 10 tears instead of 8, the tears are [[piercing]] and [[spectral]], and the tears deal 1.4 × Judas' damage, plus a flat 5.

Will only spawn [[File:Collectible Satanic Bible icon.png|link=Satanic Bible|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Satanic Bible]][[:Satanic Bible|Satanic Bible]] wisps that increase Judas' [[File:Devil Room Icon.png|link=Devil Room|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Devil Room|Devil Room]] chance by 10% for each one he has.

Invokes the effect of [[File:Collectible The Necronomicon icon.png|link=The Necronomicon|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|The Necronomicon]][[:The Necronomicon|The Necronomicon]] effect along with the original effect.
Also has a chance to invoke the effect of [[File:Collectible Golden Razor icon.png|link=Golden Razor|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Golden Razor]][[:Golden Razor|Golden Razor]].
Grants a permanent +0.5 damage up on use in addition to the temporary +4 damage up given to it by Birthright. This bonus is not lost if the broken hearts are removed.

The axe receives a purplish glow and receives the following upgrades: ** '''Increased durability''': Each use of the axe has a very high chance not to use a charge. ** '''Faster usage''': The axe can be swung up to four times per second, regardless of Judas' tears stat. ** '''Higher knockback''': Enemies are [[knock-back|knocked back]] when hit, receiving ''8 + 0.2 × floor'' damage if they collide with a wall, obstacle, or other enemies. ** '''Fire effect''': The axe will set enemies on fire. The burn deals damage equal to Judas' damage, and ticks up to 5 times. ** '''Increased luck''': destroying obstacles with the axe has an increased chance to spawn pickups. *** Destroying [[File:Poop.png|link=Poop (Disambiguation)|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Poop]][[:Poop (Disambiguation)|Poop]]s will spawn pickups much more frequently. When combined with [[File:Trinket Petrified Poop icon.png|link=Petrified Poop|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Petrified Poop]][[:Petrified Poop|Petrified Poop]], the chance becomes 100% and will often result in multiple pickups from a single poop. *** Destroying [[Tinted Rock]]s will drop more consumables than usual, similarly to [[Rocks#Super Special Rocks|Super Special Rocks]]. *** Destroying [[Rocks#Urns|Props]] (such as [[Urn]]s, [[Mushroom]]s, [[Skull]]s, and [[Polyp]]s) gives the prop an extra chance to drop its rewards. This can result in a single prop giving multiple drops. *** Destroying [[Fool's Gold]] rocks will drop significantly more coins.

In addition to the item's expected reward, spawns one of the following demonic familiars: [[File:Collectible Blood Puppy icon.png|link=Blood Puppy|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Blood Puppy]][[:Blood Puppy|Blood Puppy]], [[File:Collectible Dark Bum icon.png|link=Dark Bum|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Dark Bum]][[:Dark Bum|Dark Bum]], [[File:Collectible Demon Baby icon.png|link=Demon Baby|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Demon Baby]][[:Demon Baby|Demon Baby]], [[File:Collectible Incubus icon.png|link=Incubus|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Incubus]][[:Incubus|Incubus]], [[File:Collectible Lil Abaddon icon.png|link=Lil Abaddon|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Lil Abaddon]][[:Lil Abaddon|Lil Abaddon]], [[File:Collectible Lil Brimstone icon.png|link=Lil Brimstone|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Lil Brimstone]][[:Lil Brimstone|Lil Brimstone]], [[File:Collectible Succubus icon.png|link=Succubus|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Succubus]][[:Succubus|Succubus]], or [[File:Collectible Twisted Pair icon.png|link=Twisted Pair|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Twisted Pair]][[:Twisted Pair|Twisted Pair]].
Respawns Judas as [[File:Character Black Judas icon.png|link=Black Judas|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Judas#Black Judas|Black Judas]] if he has an extra life.
Each use grants a permanent +0.5 normal damage up in addition to a +0.2 flat damage up.

Invokes the effect of [[File:Collectible The Necronomicon icon.png|link=The Necronomicon|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|The Necronomicon]][[:The Necronomicon|The Necronomicon]] effect along with the original effect.

Grants +10.8 temporary damage up for every sacrificed familiar. The damage bonus scales down to 0 over time, similarly to [[File:Collectible Red Stew icon.png|link=Red Stew|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Red Stew]][[:Red Stew|Red Stew]]. Sacrificing blue flies or blue spiders has no special effect.

Invokes the effect of [[File:Collectible Razor Blade icon.png|link=Razor Blade|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Razor Blade]][[:Razor Blade|Razor Blade]] without dealing damage to Judas along with the original effect.

Creates a shadowy line similar to [[File:Collectible Dark Arts icon.png|link=Dark Arts|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Dark Arts]][[:Dark Arts|Dark Arts]] between Judas and the familiar. Enemies caught in the line take damage equal to 2 × Judas' damage, plus a flat 3.

Instead of dropping hearts on the floor, using The Jar consumes up to one full heart in the jar at a time, giving a temporary +0.66 damage up for each half heart consumed and spawning a puddle of [[red creep]] that deals 2 damage per tick (20 damage per second).

The stream of fire is replaced with a controllable [[File:Collectible Brimstone icon.png|link=Brimstone|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Brimstone]][[:Brimstone|Brimstone]] beam that destroys projectiles and deals more damage the longer it's active. The minimum damage is ''3.37 + 0.361 × floor'', and the maximum damage is ''4.2 + 0.45 × floor'', which it scales up to over the course of 3 seconds of continuous fire. Souls dropped from enemies are colored red, and the Urn displays a red graphic on the HUD when active.This brimstone will not be affected by any synergies, except side ones such as [[File:Collectible Angelic Prism icon.png|link=Angelic Prism|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Angelic Prism]][[:Angelic Prism|Angelic Prism]], [[File:Collectible Hemoptysis icon.png|link=Hemoptysis|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Hemoptysis]][[:Hemoptysis|Hemoptysis]] and [[File:Collectible Marked icon.png|link=Marked|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Marked]][[:Marked|Marked]].

Instead of exploding on the spot, souls home in on nearby enemies and explode on contact, similarly to [[File:Collectible Purgatory icon.png|link=Purgatory|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Purgatory]][[:Purgatory|Purgatory]]. The souls deal 2 × Judas's damage up to 3 times and destroy projectiles.
Gives a damage bonus which lasts until the next floor equal to 0.2 × the maximum number of times Wavy Cap's effects have been stacked.
